title: cousinia silyboides subsp. zardkuhensis
intro: Cousinia silyboides subsp. zardkuhensis, commonly known as Cousinia zardkuhensis, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is a type of thistle, known for its medicinal properties. Cousinia zardkuhensis is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as thymol and carvacrol, that may help soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress.
